recipe_name: Tidy Up - Cube and Bottle onto the Tray
description: Pick up the blue cube and the water bottle and place them side by side on the delivery tray

steps.description: Pick up the blue cube (auto picks a top grasp)
Place it on the near half of the tray, a top grasp can't reach as far
Pick up the water bottle (auto picks a side grasp)
Stand it on the far half of the tray, a side grasp reaches further
